## Patient: Zara – Tricompartmental Osteoarthritis of Right Knee

**HPI:**  Patient presents with significant pain and limited range of motion in the right knee following a recent diagnosis of severe osteoarthritis. History reveals progressive symptoms over the past year, exacerbated by activity. Physical examination demonstrates bony tenderness to palpation, limited flexion, and a palpable effusion.  Imaging confirms bone-on-bone medial narrowing and subchondral sclerosis.  Considering this presentation, a total knee arthroplasty is being considered as a viable treatment option.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient reports pain with activity, limited range of motion, and swelling.  Joint line tenderness noted.

**Management Plan:**  Initiate conservative management including weight loss counseling, physical therapy focusing on strengthening and range of motion exercises
